items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: Claude Williams had played the violin and he was terrific.

ctx.x: How had T. Holder managed to get this group together, especially...?

I really don't know. I never did find out but it was something really special. Claude Williams had played the violin and he was terrific. This was the most wonderful thing how they rehearsed.
